title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression thresholds and semantic-sim-metric CI hook
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: several recent regressions were surfaced only at the prompt-set level; we need per-prompt gating and a stronger semantic-similarity metric to catch paraphrase-quality drops. Summary: Add per-prompt configurable thresholds (absolute and relative), integrate a lightweight semantic-similarity metric (SBERT-based) into eval-harness metrics, and wire a new CI hook that evaluates prompt-set regressions and fails the build when quality gates are violated. Backwards-compatible: defaults keep current behavior; opt-in via eval-config. Includes unit tests and docs. Checklist: [x] design and spec (ENG-3214) completed; [x] implementation of thresholds and metric; [x] CI hook implementation; [x] unit tests; [x] docs update; [x] manual canary rollout. Testing: local unit + integration, CI runs included a transient failure for flaky eval on first run which was mitigated with retry logic. Rollout plan: merge to main, enable feature flag for canary projects, monitor eval-metrics dashboard for 48h, then flip default after stability window. Notes: the SBERT model is shipped as an optional dependency and used only in CI-environments or when explicitly enabled to avoid increasing hosted eval cost.
commits_summary: 3 commits: (1) eval-harness: add per-prompt threshold config and evaluator; (2) metrics: add semantic_similarity metric and SBERT adapter; (3) ci: add eval-harness CI hook and retry logic; tests and docs
ci_checks: eval-harness-ci: failed first run (flaky); rerun -> pass
review_comments: Miguel Santos: Please add a short-circuit to skip SBERT when the feature flag is off to avoid extra cold-start; addressed in second commit.
Riley Chen: Can we make per-prompt thresholds inherit from a global default? Suggestion: implemented with explicit override semantics; added tests.
Jordan Lee: CI hook looked fragile — added a retry with exponential backoff and clearer logging; approved after fix.
Aisha Patel (author): responded with implementation notes and added docs link.
Miguel Santos: LGTM after CI green.
release_notes: Adds opt-in per-prompt regression thresholds and a semantic-similarity CI hook to detect paraphrase/quality regressions at prompt granularity. Defaults preserve current CI behavior; enable via eval-config.
